LightningComponentBundle.description: Salesforce list views for LWR sites — saved-view tabs, search, group-by, filter chips, and save/overwrite view

property.name: newRecordLabel
property.label: Primary Action Label
property.description: Label of the header button, e.g. Add Contact. Leave blank to hide it.

property.name: viewTabs
property.label: Tab Views
property.description: Tab strip contents. JSON array of {view,label,title,subtitle,action} for per-tab headings, or the short form apiName=Label,apiName=Label. Blank shows only this view plus views the user saves.

property.name: pillFields
property.label: Pill Columns
property.description: Comma-separated field API names shown as colour-coded pills, e.g. BillingState. Each distinct value gets its own tone.

property.name: defaultColumns
property.label: Default Columns
property.description: Ordered, comma-separated field API names shown by default, e.g. Name,RecordType.Name,Type. Other columns the list view returns start switched off in Choose columns rather than being dropped. Blank keeps the list view's own columns and order. A tab's own "columns" entry in View Tabs overrides this.

property.name: availableColumns
property.label: Available Columns
property.description: Comma-separated field API names added to Choose columns but switched off by default, e.g. Custodian__c,Product_Type__c. Lets a user reach fields the list view does not carry. Needs Default Columns set, and each name is fetched eagerly, so keep it curated.

property.name: defaultListViewApiName
property.label: Default List View API Name
property.description: Usually All or All_Envelope__c depending on the object

property.name: defaultChartFieldApiName
property.label: Default Chart Field
property.description: Chart tab's initial 'Break down by' field, e.g. Status. Blank falls back to the first column with repeating values, which can land on a mostly-blank relationship column.
